description: This file contains a PHP class 'ADODB2_oci8' that extends 'ADODB_DataDict' and provides database schema management functionalities specific to Oracle OCI8 databases. It includes methods for creating SQL commands for database and table modifications, handling data types, and managing sequences and triggers.

classes.name: ADODB2_oci8
classes.description: A PHP class providing Oracle OCI8 specific database schema management methods.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Determines the internal type code for a given data type and size.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Returns the database-specific data type string for a given type code.

methods.name: CreateDatabase
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to create a new Oracle user (schema).

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to add columns to an existing table.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to modify columns in an existing table.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop columns from a table.

methods.name: _DropAutoIncrement
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop auto-increment sequences.

methods.name: _CreateSuffix
methods.description: Builds SQL suffix for column creation with default, nullability, and constraints.

methods.name: _Triggers
methods.description: Generates trigger and sequence creation SQL for auto-increment emulation.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Builds SQL for creating or dropping indexes on tables.

methods.name: GetCommentSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to retrieve comments on a column.

methods.name: SetCommentSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to set comment on a column.
